cases.title: An unknown --kind or --mode exits 2 with one JSON error
cases.given: A scratch git repo and the shipped skill directory.
cases.when: name and list run with --kind bogus, SLICE, '', 'slice ', Slice, e2e_area; preflight runs with --mode bogus, PR, '', 'pr ', Direct.
cases.then: Each run exits 2 and prints one {ok:false, error} line, empty stderr, no usage text.
cases.expected: Exit 2 with the JSON error object.

evidence.title: re-run of r0 case
evidence.inline:
$ python3 <skill>/branches.py list --repo <repo> --kind SLICE
exit: 2
--- stdout
{"ok": false, "error": "--kind 'SLICE' is not one of run, slice, milestone, e2e, e2e-area, state, verify, attempt"}
--- stderr
(empty)

cases.title: A git-modes.json that cannot be read fails preflight with one JSON error and exit 2, not exit 1
cases.given: Two copied skill directories: git-modes.json is a directory; git-modes.json has mode 000.
cases.when: preflight --mode pr runs with each copy; parse, name and list run with each copy.
cases.then: preflight exits 2 with one {ok:false, error} line and empty stderr; the other commands exit 0.
cases.actual: Exit 2 for both shapes. The error reads 'cannot read <path>: [Errno 21] Is a directory' and '[Errno 13] Permission denied'. Stderr is empty. The other three commands exit 0. The r0 failure is fixed by 4434d71.

cases.title: Other git-modes.json shapes near the fix fail preflight with one JSON error and exit 2
cases.given: Eight copied skill directories: 100000-deep nested list, a symlink loop, a dangling symlink, an empty file, UTF-16 with BOM, top-level null, gitModes as an object, an empty-string mode.

cases.title: A --repo directory that cannot be read, a FIFO and a non-git directory give exit 0 or a JSON error, never a traceback
cases.given: A directory with mode 000, a FIFO and a plain directory with no .git.
cases.when: parse and preflight run on the FIFO; name and preflight run on the plain directory; parse and list run on the mode-000 directory with and without --format.

seeds.title: A --repo directory that cannot be read passes when --format is given
seeds.detail: With mode 000 on --repo, parse exits 2 without --format (config.json read fails) but exits 0 with --format, because _repo checks only os.path.isdir (TC-cli-23). Later slices that run git in --repo will meet the error there. Consider an os.access(repo, R_OK | X_OK) check in _repo.

seeds.title: GIT_MODES_PATH still uses abspath, not realpath
seeds.detail: The fix made the three scripts resolve their directory through realpath. branches.py builds GIT_MODES_PATH from os.path.abspath(__file__). A branches.py run through a symlink in another directory reads git-modes.json beside the symlink, or reports it missing. Not tested here; out of VS-5 scope.
